title: Known-object test, TOI-3445.01
summary: Known-object test on TOI-3445.01: positive control on the catalogued transit(s), calibrated screen for further dips, catalogue cross-match. Runner: Calibration on each light curve (sign-flip null, injection–recovery): k* ≤2.5, 3; at the declared k = 5 the screen recovers ≥90% of 4-h dips only from depth none on grid, none on grid (completeness for 2000 ppm: 0%, 0%). The null result excludes only dips deeper than that. Positive control: catalogued transit gap, partial, recovered (19 covered epochs). Residual screen: 25 threshold entries outside the known-signal veto across 2 light curve(s), forming 14 distinct event(s), 2 persistent in SAP and PDCSAP at two or more baselines. Repeat candidate: a persistent event matching the catalogued depth at BJD 2461153.0491 (ΔT 1083.75 d); 42 period aliases remain. Unverified lead until vetted.
